en: The image is a black-and-white photograph showing a panoramic view of a leafy residential area with rows of early 20th-century houses and apartment buildings surrounded by trees. The sky is partly cloudy, with a wide expanse of forest visible in the distance. In the lower left corner, there is white printed text describing the location, while additional text at the bottom right credits a photography studio in Helsingborg.
